name: read_project_doc
title: Read a project document
description: Read the decision log, roadmap or lessons from the head of the default branch, fresh from the remote; pass the returned commit as base_commit to write_project_docs. A long file comes in parts (total_lines); exists false: not in the repository yet. Internal conversations only; needs no owner request.

line_count.description: How many lines to return, at most 2000 (default 2000).
